owner.name: Meridian Vocational College / Adelaide Culinary Institute

plugins.name: vet-assessment
plugins.description: Build audit-compliant Australian VET assessment packs matched to the RTO's own approved templates, then the matching teaching resources: paired learner and assessor Word documents with model answers, benchmarks and generated recipe photography; a branded Learner Guide and Delivery PowerPoint built from the finished pack; and a compliance report. Includes the docx-images artwork sub-skill.

plugins.name: vet-marking
plugins.description: Mark a batch of submitted student assessments for one unit and produce the records an RTO keeps - marked copies carrying a cover sheet, a feedback page and a coloured outcome in every response, standalone Student Feedback Sheets for anyone with nothing coming back, Student Assessment Records and the class Assessment Marking and Results Record - from the unit prerequisites on training.gov.au, the WiseNet enrolment matrix and the RTO's own templates. Includes the rto-validation-docs skill for the controlled assessment-validation document set.
